request.message:
Update this standing weekly production digest to Week 8. This is the same document every week - edit it in place. Make exactly the changes below and nothing else.

STEP 1 - STATUS LINE. The bold status line directly under the document title must read exactly:
  Week 8 · 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-01 · Phase: Vertical Slice
Leave the smaller grey line beneath it unchanged.

STEP 2 - ARCHIVE. The 'Archive' table's data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 2 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells shown in angle brackets are for you to write.
  Row 1: 'Week 7' | '2026-02-16 to 2026-02-22' | <your own summary, at most 20 words, of the bullets currently under 'What changed'> | <your own summary, at most 15 words, of the rows currently in the 'What is at risk' table>
  Row 2: 'Week 1' | '2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11' | 'Art style and Nav-mesh tasks were narrowed and completed.' | 'Unversioned save-games, boss tuning, and character art slips.'

STEP 3 - 'What changed'. Replace ALL bullets in that section with exactly these 2 bullets, verbatim, in this order:
  - Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish
  - Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag

STEP 4 - 'What is at risk' table. The data rows must end up being exactly these 2 rows, in this order. Update, add or delete rows as needed; keep the header row and the table styling untouched.
  | Risk | Owner | Area | Severity | Trend |
  | Crash rate above the cert threshold | Dev H. | QA | Medium | steady |
  | No accessibility sign-off for subtitle sizing | Ana F. | Design | Low | steady |
 Risks closed this week and therefore absent from the list above: Save-game format still unversioned; Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCU; Second combat designer starts late.

STEP 5 - 'What is next'. Replace ALL bullets in that section with exactly these 2 bullets, verbatim, in this order:
  - Get the slice in front of the publisher
  - Second external playtest, 20 players

Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections.
STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain <table> elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.
